# BepInEx runtime dependency

The Bazaar Skin Manager redistributes the unmodified Windows x64 archive of
BepInEx 5.4.23.5 so the skin runtime works without BazaarPlusPlus or another
mod manager.

- Upstream: https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx
- Release: https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases/tag/v5.4.23.5
- Archive: `BepInEx_win_x64_5.4.23.5.zip`
- SHA-256: `82f9878551030f54657792c0740d9d51a09500eeae1fba21106b0c441e6732c4`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE.txt` in this directory.

The Skin Manager installs only BepInEx itself. It does not install the
BazaarPlusPlus plugin.
